跟著米其林與在地名店
吃遍台灣學英文Eat Taiwan with Michelin & local favourites, learn English

from Michelin stars to fifty-dollar sausages

從米其林星級餐廳、老字號台菜館、私廚，到夜市的蚵仔煎、烤玉米和水果攤。每一站都附地址、導航、招牌菜，還有一句可以直接拿去點餐的英文。From Michelin-starred restaurants, classic Taiwanese banquet halls and private kitchens to oyster omelets and grilled corn at the night market. Every stop comes with an address, directions, signature dishes, and an English line you can use to order.

    每道菜都有一篇美食故事：中英對照、可以聽英文朗讀，讀完學關鍵單字和實用句，再看做法、去玩這道菜的遊戲。Every dish has a story in Chinese and English that you can listen to. Then learn the key words and phrases, see the recipe and play its games.

    12 道台灣經典美食的家常做法：食材、步驟都有中英對照，每一步都能聽英文。步驟裡標色的字是烹調動詞。Home-style recipes for 12 Taiwanese classics, with bilingual ingredients and steps you can listen to. Highlighted words are cooking verbs.
